faqs.question: What is the LMS module?
faqs.answer: The LMS (Learning Management System) is where you complete your assigned training courses to build your business knowledge as part of the TEF programme.

faqs.question: Why do I need to complete the LMS?
faqs.answer: Completing the LMS is required as part of the programme requirements and helps you gain the knowledge needed for your business.

faqs.question: When can I access the LMS?
faqs.answer: You can access the LMS after your onboarding and verification have been successfully completed.

faqs.question: Why can't I access the LMS?
faqs.answer: LMS access is available after the required onboarding and verification steps are completed. If you have completed them and still cannot access the LMS, please use the available support option.

faqs.question: What is the Participation Agreement?
faqs.answer: The Participation Agreement outlines the terms and conditions for participating in the training programme.

faqs.question: Is accepting the Participation Agreement mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must accept the Participation Agreement before you can start your training.

faqs.question: Why can't I see the Participation Agreement anymore?
faqs.answer: The Participation Agreement is displayed only the first time you access the LMS. Once accepted, it will not appear again.

faqs.question: What is the difference between General Training and Programme Training?
faqs.answer: General Training is available to candidates who have accessed the TEFConnect platform, while Programme Training is intended for entrepreneurs enrolled in a programme.

faqs.question: How do I select a training?
faqs.answer: After entering the LMS, choose General Training or Programme Training and then select the available or assigned course.

faqs.question: How do I choose a course?
faqs.answer: Select the course assigned to you from the available course list.

faqs.question: Can I change my selected course?
faqs.answer: You can access the courses available or assigned to you. If you believe there is an issue with your course assignment, please use the available support option.

faqs.question: What information is available before starting a course?
faqs.answer: You can view the course description, requirements, learning outcomes, and curriculum before starting.

faqs.question: How do I start learning?
faqs.answer: Open your selected course and click Start Learning to begin with the pre-test.

faqs.question: What learning materials are available in the course?
faqs.answer: Courses may include videos, presentations (PPTs), case studies, and quizzes (MCQs).

faqs.question: Is the pre-test mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pre-test must be completed before you begin the learning modules.

faqs.question: Can I skip the pre-test?
faqs.answer: No. The pre-test must be completed before you begin the learning modules.

faqs.question: Does the pre-test have a pass/fail requirement?
faqs.answer: No. The pre-test is used to assess your knowledge before the training and does not have a pass/fail requirement.

faqs.question: Is the post-test mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. The post-test must be completed before finishing the course.

faqs.question: Can I skip the post-test?
faqs.answer: No. The post-test must be completed before you finish the course.

faqs.question: Does the post-test have a pass/fail requirement?
faqs.answer: No. The post-test is used to measure the change in your knowledge after the training and does not have a pass/fail requirement.

faqs.question: Can I retake the assessment?
faqs.answer: Assessment retakes are not available.

faqs.question: How do I track my course progress?
faqs.answer: Your course page displays your module progress, completed content, and the last updated date.

faqs.question: Can I see my course progress?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your course page displays your module progress, completed content, and the last updated information.

faqs.question: Why is my progress not updating?
faqs.answer: Ensure you have completed the required learning activity and that your internet connection is stable. If the issue continues, use the available support option.

faqs.question: Why is my progress not being saved?
faqs.answer: Ensure you have a stable internet connection and allow the page to finish loading before exiting. If the issue continues, use the available support option.

faqs.question: How do I mark my course as completed?
faqs.answer: After completing all required learning activities and the post-test, click Mark as Completed.

faqs.question: Why is my course not showing as completed?
faqs.answer: Make sure you have completed all required modules, the post-test, and clicked Mark as Completed.

faqs.question: What should I do if I have completed the course but it still shows as incomplete?
faqs.answer: Check that all required activities and the post-test are completed and that you selected Mark as Completed. If it still shows incomplete, use the available support option.

faqs.question: How much time do I have to complete the training?
faqs.answer: The course deadline is set by the programme administrator. Complete your training before the deadline.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the training deadline?
faqs.answer: If you do not complete the LMS within the specified timeline, you may be removed from the programme.

faqs.question: Can I continue my course from where I left off?
faqs.answer: Your course page displays your progress and last updated information. If your progress is not being retained, check your internet connection and use the available support option if the issue continues.

faqs.question: How do I set a reminder?
faqs.answer: Use the reminder option available in the course to receive reminders for your learning schedule.

faqs.question: How do I use the Discussion Forum?
faqs.answer: Open the Discussion Forum within your course to ask questions and interact with other entrepreneurs enrolled in the same course.

faqs.question: Can I ask questions in the Discussion Forum?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can post questions and participate in discussions with other entrepreneurs enrolled in the same course.

faqs.question: How do I rate a module?
faqs.answer: After completing a module, you will be prompted to submit your rating and feedback.

faqs.question: Why should I rate a module?
faqs.answer: Your feedback provides input on the quality of the training content and learning experience.
